I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes a lot of sense. When you’ve had letdowns before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase.

A few things about our plants that may help:

All of our roses are premium, own-root, grown at our nurseries in Oregon (we don’t buy from third-party growers), which gives better long-term vigor than grafted or mass‑produced plants.
Every rose is shipped in a 1-gallon container with soil, defoliated on purpose so it travels well and can focus on new growth once planted.
We stand behind our plants with a one-year guarantee for roses and a 90-day guarantee for perennials, because we expect them to do well for you.
